game_title: Call Stack Tower – Frozen Gatehouse Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the frozen well using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the frozen well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
